jobs.occupation: PhD epidemiology of kidney replacement therapy in Europe
jobs.description: We are looking for an enthusiastic PhD _tudent to perform epidemiological research on patients treated by dialysis or kidney transplantation in an international environment. You will conduct epidemiological research on patients receiving kidney replacement therapy across European countries, investigating its occurrence, patient characteristics, and clinical outcomes. By expanding our database with newly available variables, you will address important knowledge gaps and explore new research questions in the fields of dialysis and kidney transplantation. You will analyze data and publish your findings in scientific papers that will form the basis of your PhD thesis. By identifying differences between countries, your research may contribute to a better understanding of kidney care across Europe and support country-specific healthcare planning and prioritization. Would you like to know more about the different phases within the PhD trajectory? You can read more about this on this page. You will conduct epidemiological research on patients with kidney disease across European countries, primarily utilizing data from the European Renal Association (ERA) Registry. This is a large European registry that collects data on patients with kidney failure undergoing dialysis or kidney transplantation from around 35 countries across Europe. In addition to your research, you will contribute to the annual data collection of the ERA Registry, and will assist in the publication of the ERA Registry’s annual report and related scientific articles. Currently the team consists of several senior/postdoctoral researchers, three PhD _tudents, a data manager and a management assistant who work intensively together and with nephrologists from different European countries. Throughout your PhD project, you will have the opportunity to fosteryour professional growth by participating in various courses, including those in epidemiology and scientific writing. an MSc degree in the field ofepidemiology, medicine, pharmacy, nutrition, medical informatics or (biomedical) health science; a strong motivation to pursue a PhD in epidemiological research; enthusiasm to participate in data collection processes; a service-oriented approach to communicating with international partners; proficiency in English, with strong written and oral communication skills; a detail-oriented approach to ensure high data quality and scientific accuracy. Applicants must hold a Master’s degree that is recognised and valid in the Netherlands. It is the applicant’s own responsibility to verify that their degree meets this requirement before applying. We are unable to assess or confirm the validity or recognition of individual diplomas by email. You will be employed by Amsterdam UMC Research BV. A contract for 12 months, with the intention to extend for a total of four years. The Guideline PhD contract applies to this vacancy. Classification in salary scale OIO: € 3.217 to € 4.077 gross for full-time employment (depending on experience). In addition to a good basic salary, we offer 8.3% end-of-year bonus. Medical doctors that are BIG-registered in the Netherlands are classified in salary scale 10: € 3.724 to € 5.867 gross for full-time employment (depending on experience). Take advantage of our good bike scheme. Pension accrual with BeFrank, a modern, comprehensible and fairly priced pension. jobs.description: For our engineering team in Porto, we are looking for an Electrical Design Engineer with experience in EPLAN. In this role, you will work remotely from Portugal for a leading Dutch engineering company active in heavy lifting, offshore/marine cranes and hoisting equipment. You will be involved in the electrical design of complex lifting systems used in demanding environments such as offshore, marine, wind energy and heavy industry. This is a great opportunity for an engineer who enjoys technically challenging projects and wants to work on high-end equipment where safety, reliability and precision are essential. What you will do As an Electrical Design Engineer, you will be responsible for creating and maintaining electrical designs in EPLAN. You will work closely with mechanical engineers, automation engineers, project engineers and the Dutch customer team. Your responsibilities include: Creating electrical schematics in EPLAN Electric P8; Designing control cabinet layouts, terminal diagrams, cable lists and BOMs; Working on electrical systems for cranes, hoisting equipment and heavy lifting solutions; Supporting the selection of electrical components, sensors, drives and control systems; Working with motor control, VFDs, safety circuits, limit switches and load monitoring systems; Preparing technical documentation for production, commissioning and service; Reviewing and updating drawings based on project changes, client specifications or as-built information; Contributing to safe, reliable and maintainable electrical designs; Collaborating with international engineering teams in English. Arbeidsvoorwaarden You will become part of Xelvin Portugal and work from our office in the Porto region. From Portugal, you will contribute to engineering projects for a Dutch customer, while being part of an international and growing engineering environment. We offer: Between 2000 and 2750 A challenging engineering role in offshore, marine and heavy lifting technology; Theopportunity to work for a leading Dutch company in high-end crane and hoisting equipment; A professional workplace in the Porto region; International collaboration with experienced engineers in the Netherlands; Room to grow technically and professionally; A role where your work directly contributes to safe and reliable lifting systems; Support from Xelvin Portugal during your onboarding and development. Functie-eisen We are looking for an engineer with a strong technical mindset and a practical approach to electrical design. Experience in heavy lifting or offshore/marine equipment is a plus, but not mandatory. Relevant experience in machine building, industrial automation, material handling, shipbuilding or heavy equipment is also highly valuable. You bring: At least 2 years of experience as an Electrical Design Engineer, EPLAN Engineer or similar; Good experience with EPLAN; A technical background in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics or a similar field; Experience with electrical schematics, control cabinets, cable lists, terminal diagrams and BOMs; Knowledge of industrial components such as drives, sensors, motors, safety relays, PLC I/O and control systems; An interest in working on cranes, hoisting systems and heavy lifting equipment; Good communication skills in English; A structured and accurate way of working; The ability to work independently while staying connected to an international project team. Nice to have The following experience is considered a plus: Experience with offshore, marine, cranes, hoisting systems or heavy machinery; Knowledge of standards such as IEC 60204-1, IEC 60204-32, EN ISO 13849 or IEC 62061; Experience with Siemens, ABB, Schneider, Rockwell, Pilz or similar systems; Experience with safety circuits, functional safety, drives or motor control; Interest in new technologies and future engineering possibilities, such as AI, automation tools or digital engineering workflows.
